description: Make agents run the full CI (python test/run_ci.py) before finishing a turn that changed files.

hooks.command: python3 -c "import os,runpy,sys; p=os.path.join('.','test','agent_ci_gate.py'); sys.argv=[p,'pre']; os.path.isfile(p) and runpy.run_path(p,run_name='__main__')"
hooks.commandWindows: py -3.13 -c "import os,runpy,sys; p=os.path.join('.','test','agent_ci_gate.py'); sys.argv=[p,'pre']; os.path.isfile(p) and runpy.run_path(p,run_name='__main__')"
